name: YepAPI
description: Unified pay-per-use API for SEO and backlink research, SERPs, Google Maps, scraping, AI chat and media, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Amazon, and email intelligence. YepAPI is an independent aggregator and is not affiliated with Yep.com.

tools.name: media_queue
tools.description: Submit one asynchronous YepAPI image, video, music, speech, image-analysis, or video-analysis job. Model-specific pricing applies. Supply the documented model id plus only inputs supported by that model, then poll media_status until completed or failed; do not submit the same paid job repeatedly.

tools.name: media_status
